sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

contentPattern.structure: repeating [label] | [value] rows rendered as a definition list

suitableFor: key/value specification panels (Activity, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price, etc.)
product / adventure fact sheets rendered as a definition list
compact label-over-value or label/value spec sidebars
notSuitableFor: generic wide tabular data with many columns (use the table block)

notes: Bespoke block (no Block Collection base) created for the WKND adventure detail spec panel. Source is an AEM content-fragment definition list (dt=label, dd=value). Content model: first row = block name 'adventure-details'; each subsequent row = 2 cells [label] | [value]. Decoration emits a semantic <dl> with .adventure-details-item groups, each holding a <dt class=adventure-details-label> and <dd class=adventure-details-value>. The 'table' block was considered but rejected: a purpose-built definition-list keeps the label/value semantics and matches the left-column spec design. Uses only plain DOM APIs - no aem.js/scripts.js import (this stripped @adobe/aem-boilerplate does not export moveInstrumentation or fetchPlaceholders).
